evo-parser.label: Evolution parser
evo-parser.framework: Evolution CMS core on Laravel (Illuminate) components (+ Symfony http-foundation/finder)

evo-latte.label: Evolution + Latte
evo-latte.framework: Evolution CMS core on Laravel (Illuminate) components + Latte (+ Symfony http-foundation/finder)

evo-latte-parser.label: Evolution + Latte + EVO pass
evo-latte-parser.framework: Evolution CMS core on Laravel (Illuminate) components + Latte, with the core tag pass over the view output (+ Symfony http-foundation/finder)

evo-phalcon.label: Evolution + aPhalcon
evo-phalcon.framework: Evolution CMS core on Laravel (Illuminate) components + Phalcon DB adapter + Latte (+ Symfony http-foundation/finder)

evo-sarticles.label: Evolution + sArticles
evo-sarticles.framework: Evolution CMS core on Laravel (Illuminate) components + the sArticles module, whose Eloquent models carry the articles instead of the document tree

evo-worker.label: Evolution parser, FrankenPHP worker
evo-worker.framework: Evolution CMS core on Laravel (Illuminate) components (+ Symfony http-foundation/finder) in FrankenPHP worker mode: a new application per request

evo-worker-keep.label: Evolution parser, FrankenPHP worker, kept app
evo-worker-keep.framework: Evolution CMS core on Laravel (Illuminate) components (+ Symfony http-foundation/finder) in FrankenPHP worker mode: one booted application per worker, reset after each request (EVO_WORKER_KEEP_APP=1)

evo-latte-worker.label: Evolution + Latte, FrankenPHP worker
evo-latte-worker.framework: Evolution CMS core on Laravel (Illuminate) components + Latte (+ Symfony http-foundation/finder) in FrankenPHP worker mode: a new application per request

evo-latte-worker-keep.label: Evolution + Latte, FrankenPHP worker, kept app
evo-latte-worker-keep.framework: Evolution CMS core on Laravel (Illuminate) components + Latte (+ Symfony http-foundation/finder) in FrankenPHP worker mode: one booted application per worker, reset after each request (EVO_WORKER_KEEP_APP=1)

evo-latte-parser-worker.label: Evolution + Latte + EVO pass, FrankenPHP worker
evo-latte-parser-worker.framework: Evolution CMS core on Laravel (Illuminate) components + Latte, with the core tag pass over the view output (+ Symfony http-foundation/finder) in FrankenPHP worker mode: a new application per request

evo-latte-parser-worker-keep.label: Evolution + Latte + EVO pass, FrankenPHP worker, kept app
evo-latte-parser-worker-keep.framework: Evolution CMS core on Laravel (Illuminate) components + Latte, with the core tag pass over the view output (+ Symfony http-foundation/finder) in FrankenPHP worker mode: one booted application per worker, reset after each request (EVO_WORKER_KEEP_APP=1)

evo-phalcon-worker.label: Evolution + aPhalcon, FrankenPHP worker
evo-phalcon-worker.framework: Evolution CMS core on Laravel (Illuminate) components + Phalcon DB adapter + Latte (+ Symfony http-foundation/finder) in FrankenPHP worker mode: a new application per request

evo-phalcon-worker-keep.label: Evolution + aPhalcon, FrankenPHP worker, kept app
evo-phalcon-worker-keep.framework: Evolution CMS core on Laravel (Illuminate) components + Phalcon DB adapter + Latte (+ Symfony http-foundation/finder) in FrankenPHP worker mode: one booted application per worker, reset after each request (EVO_WORKER_KEEP_APP=1)

evo-frankenphp.label: Evolution parser, FrankenPHP classic
evo-frankenphp.framework: Evolution CMS core on Laravel (Illuminate) components (+ Symfony http-foundation/finder), served by classic FrankenPHP with a fresh application lifecycle on every request

drupal.label: Drupal
drupal.framework: Drupal core on Symfony HttpKernel/Routing + Twig

typo3.label: TYPO3
typo3.framework: TYPO3 core on Doctrine DBAL + Fluid (Symfony DI/translation only)

winter.label: Winter CMS
winter.framework: Winter CMS (Storm + CMS module) on Laravel (Illuminate) + Twig (+ Symfony http-foundation/translation; PDO wrapped in the Doctrine DBAL PDOConnection)

modx.label: MODX Revolution
modx.framework: MODX Revolution core (modRequest/modParser) on xPDO, its own ORM over PDO; no third-party framework on the request path

wordpress-gantry.label: WordPress + Gantry 5
wordpress-gantry.framework: WordPress core (wpdb, WP_Rewrite, WP_Query) with the Gantry 5 framework plugin rendering the Hydrogen theme through Timber and Twig 2 (+ Symfony yaml/event-dispatcher for the outline); no other framework on the request path
